svg.title: Rule tablet: The Clerk's Charter
svg.desc: The Clerk's Charter, cut in a square slab of slate and streaked by rain: six rules, with Hollin and window underlined.
svg.text: The weather of Hollin is written by the
The weather of Hollin is written by the
Clerk alone.
Clerk alone.
The Clerk is chosen at the death of the
The Clerk is chosen at the death of the
Clerk before.
Clerk before.
What is written in the Day-Book is the day.
What is written in the Day-Book is the day.
No page of the Day-Book may be torn or
No page of the Day-Book may be torn or
crossed.
crossed.
The Clerk's chair is not to be sat in by any
The Clerk's chair is not to be sat in by any
other.
other.
Every house in Hollin keeps a window to the
Every house in Hollin keeps a window to the
sky.
sky.
